title: Apache server-info page served
description: The response is the Apache server-info handler: the Server Settings and module list that the server generates for its own configuration. It names the loaded modules, their versions, the virtual hosts and the configuration files.
remediation: Disable the server-info handler, or restrict it to the administrative network.
limitation: One response body. The rule reports the handler output; it does not read the configuration files it names.
